content.short: Autograph is a sports NFT marketplace.
content.description: Autograph is a sports NFT marketplace founded by Tom Brady that partners with legendary athletes to sell on-chain collectibles. Athletes such as Usain Bolt, Tiger Woods, and Simone Biles have collaborated with Autograph, translating their signatures into exclusive NFTs that live on the blockchain. Based in Los Angeles, the platform is designed to make it easier for fans to obtain autographs from their favorite athletes as digital, on-chain memorabilia. Autograph focuses on connecting fans with iconic sports figures through blockchain-based collectibles.
